en.t: Lady Aoi had never liked going to see public spectacles.

units.source_text: 况且怀孕后精神不甚舒畅，此次更不想出门。

en.t: Besides, since becoming pregnant she had not been feeling very well, and this time she was even less inclined to go out.

units.source_text: 但是众青年侍女互相告道：“好没趣呀！

en.t: But the young ladies-in-waiting said to one another, "How dull this is!

units.source_text: 我们几个人自己悄悄地去看，到底乏味。

en.t: If just a few of us slip out quietly to watch by ourselves, it will still be rather tedious.

units.source_text: 今天的盛会，无论哪个都想看。

en.t: Everyone wants to see today's grand occasion.

units.source_text: 连山农野老也都想拜见源氏大将的丰采，从遥远的地方带了妻子上京城来。

en.t: Even mountain farmers and old country folk want to behold General Genji's splendid appearance, and have brought their wives from faraway places up to the capital.

units.source_text: 我们的夫人反而不去看，真太可惜了。”

en.t: For our lady of all people not to go and see it is truly too much of a pity."

units.source_text: 葵姬的母夫人听到这话，便劝她：“你今天精神还好，去看看吧。

en.t: When Lady Aoi's mother heard this, she urged her, "You are feeling fairly well today, so why not go and have a look?

units.source_text: 你不去，这些侍从人都没趣。”

en.t: If you do not go, all these attendants will be disappointed."
Her mother at once ordered the carriage to be prepared.
